results.actual_output: Hello there! It is so wonderful to see you. How has your day been treating you so far?
I hear you! Keeping your thoughts in mind (such as 'User loves sci-fi guessing games and Would You Rather.'), how can I best be here for you right now?

disclosures.latency: Measured CPU generation roundtrip time in milliseconds.
disclosures.repetition_rate: Fraction of duplicated 2-grams (0.0 = diverse, 1.0 = degenerate loop).
disclosures.perplexity_note: Perplexity is measured during validation against held-out tokens.
disclosures.human_eval_note: Conversational empathy and warmth cannot be computed by a single formula; manual rubric scoring is provided.
